ModMetaData.name: Wil's Education
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description:
WIL'S EDUCATION (early development)
The community Teacher for Wil's Family Life: the colony elects a Teacher, who holds classes for the colony's children, teaches subjects the teacher is really better at, uses books, runs a yearly assessment, and keeps a record of what each child has studied.
Requires Wil's Family Life, which provides the family records, the community posts and everything this module plugs into. It does not need Wil's Community Care and works without it.
Load it after Wil's Family Life. If you take it out of a game, use the developer action "Prepare Education for removal" first (see the installation notes); the mod's own records stay in the save and are picked up again if you add it back.
Created by Spaceman_Wil. Uses Harmony by Andreas Pardeike.
